title: Time & focus
description: See active time, focus, app usage, and the shape of your day.
outcome: See where measured active time went and choose one concrete change to protect the next focused work period.
decisions: Which projects and applications received the most active time?
Where did task switching break sustained work?
What is one evidence-backed adjustment for the next period?
trustBoundary: Active time excludes idle gaps; project labels and focus patterns remain unavailable where capture cannot support them.

blocks.title: Active time
blocks.intent: Calculate total active computer time inside the selected period, excluding idle gaps. Return the duration in minutes or hours and describe coverage gaps.

blocks.title: Longest sustained work
blocks.intent: Report the longest evidence-backed interval of active work on one project or workstream. State the continuity and idle-gap rule in the delta field; return unavailable when project continuity cannot be supported.

blocks.title: Time by application
blocks.intent: Group active time in the selected period by application and return the largest categories with durations in minutes.

blocks.title: Workstream transitions
blocks.intent: Count evidence-backed transitions between different projects or workstreams in evenly spaced intervals. Do not count application changes inside the same supported workstream, and show coverage gaps instead of assigning a focus score.

blocks.title: Time by project
blocks.intent: Group active time in the selected period by evidence-backed project or workstream. Use Unclassified when the project cannot be determined.

blocks.title: Activity timeline
blocks.intent: Show the major work intervals in chronological order for the selected period, with timestamps, applications, and concise activity context.

blocks.title: One change for the next period
blocks.intent: Recommend one small, reversible change to protect sustained work in the next period, tied to a specific measured pattern above. Define what to observe next time and avoid treating application category as productivity.
